On 'fwgr40-n3 Notes Bench Dashboard' (uid {{v5}}) I opened the top-bar refresh-rate dropdown ("Auto refresh turned off…" / Off) and selected "1m"; the top bar then showed 1m. I clicked Save dashboard, the save drawer initially showed "No changes to save" with Save disabled, so I ticked "Update default refresh value" (this is the refresh-interval analogue of the default-time-range checkbox in this Grafana 11.3 build), which enabled the Save button, then clicked Save and a success alert was raised and the drawer closed. After a full page reload the refresh dropdown reads "1m" (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected") and the URL carries refresh=1m, confirming persistence. Note: the confirmation alert text was not captured verbatim in a read after the save (the alert had auto-dismissed and no alert element remained in the DOM when I checked); persistence of the setting across a reload is the evidence that the save succeeded.
